name: Vantage

categories.label: Destiny completed
categories.hint: One of the destiny goals (e.g. escaping the planet) completed

winCondition: Game ends when a player completes a mission or a destiny, or a player's health, morale or time reaches 0 a second time. Mission victory, destiny victory, or epic victory (both).

endCondition.description: Ends on mission or destiny completion, or when a player's health, morale or time hits 0 a second time.

notes: family: coop. No points. Epic victory = both mission and destiny in the same game. Official rulebook is in a Dropbox folder (too large to download) and the box; verified only against the Stonemaier rules/FAQ page. Intrinsic (self-defined) success not modelled. Check rulebook before upgrading confidence.
